legacy_benchmark: tests/bench_rerank_routing.py (22 prompts, 15/22 top-3) is retained unchanged as the fast regression guard and is NOT part of this file
labeling_rules: An acceptable tool is one whose own docstring and input contract answer the request, not one whose name reads similarly.
Several tools are listed when more than one genuinely answers, for example a tool and its bulk or paginated variant.
Metered RapidAPI tools (blueteam_ioc_search, blueteam_ioc_search_bulk, blueteam_ip_intel_bulk, blueteam_breach_check) are never the only acceptable tool, because the scheduled budget refuses them.
Opt-in tools are labelled where the request matches their capability, but every opt-in intent also accepts a non-opt-in tool when the documented degrade path uses one.
split_rule: Explicit per record in the split field. Records sharing a pair value always share a split, so a wording variant cannot leak between development and held-out evaluation. Pairs were rebalanced once, before any router was measured, to reach roughly 60 percent development: 9 held pairs moved to development, recorded in this file rather than recomputed, so the split cannot drift.

label_review.method: Read every Indonesian prompt beside its English partner after the first held-out run. Prompt wording and labels were NOT changed: v1 results stay as measured, and any wording change goes into a new version.
label_review.labels_confirmed_correct: All 170 records. Thirteen held-out pairs scored English-correct and Indonesian-incorrect, and in every one the acceptable set still answers the request. The misses are router recall, not label error.

naturalness_findings.proposed: 'menghubungi server C2 secara berkala' or 'callback berkala'
naturalness_findings.impact: Development split only, so it did not affect any held-out number.

naturalness_findings.issue: 'Daftarkan' means register or subscribe, not list.
naturalness_findings.impact: Held out. The router missed on the shared token 'manager', not on the verb.

naturalness_findings.issue: 'dokumen peringatan mentah' reads as paperwork; the request is about alert records.
naturalness_findings.impact: Held out. The miss came from the alias map turning 'dokumen' into 'document pdf'.

naturalness_findings.issue: 'area startup' is non-idiomatic for a persistence check.
naturalness_findings.impact: Held out. The router matched on 'area' and 'attacker' instead.

label_review.idiom_check: Six Indonesian prompts use English technical borrowings on purpose (korpus, netblock, playbook, threat hunt, deployment, decoder, false positive), matching how Indonesian SOC teams write. These are not translation defects.
